walkthroughs.title: Approve or reject a visitor
walkthroughs.description: The guard asks about an unexpected visitor. The resident opens the request and approves or rejects it, then sees it in the visitor history.

walkthroughs.title: Pre-approve a guest
walkthroughs.description: The resident creates a pass for an expected guest and sees the QR pass to share.

walkthroughs.title: Parcel waiting at the gate
walkthroughs.description: The resident checks a parcel that the guard is holding at the gate.
